WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', ORDERED_AT) AS month, SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS revenue
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       revenue,
       LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prior_month_revenue,
       CASE 
         WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE 100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)
       END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

         ELSE NULL

FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month

WITH store_revenue AS (
  SELECT s.STORE_NAME,
         SUM(o.SUBTOTAL) AS store_revenue
  FROM ORDERS o
  JOIN STORES s ON o.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID
  GROUP BY s.STORE_NAME
),

  SELECT SUM(SUBTOTAL) AS company_revenue
  FROM ORDERS
)

       100.0 * sr.store_revenue / tr.company_revenue AS revenue_share_pct
FROM store_revenue sr

ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC

WITH customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM ORDERS
  GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
  WHERE order_count >= 2
),
total_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM customer_order_counts
)
SELECT 100.0 * repeat_count / total_count AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM repeat_customers, total_customers

         COALESCE(l.spend_last_90, 0) AS spend_last_90,
         COALESCE(p.spend_prior_90, 0) AS spend_prior_90
  FROM last_90 l

)

  SELECT
    DATE '2026-06-17' AS today,
    DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 90 DAY AS last_90_start,
    DATE '2026-06-17' - INTERVAL 180 DAY AS prior_90_start,

    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN o.ORDERED_AT >= (SELECT last_90_start FROM date_ranges)
      THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
      ELSE 0 
    END) AS last_90_revenue,
    SUM(CASE 
      WHEN o.ORDERED_AT >= (SELECT prior_90_start FROM date_ranges)
        AND o.ORDERED_AT < (SELECT prior_90_end FROM date_ranges)
      THEN o.SUBTOTAL 
      ELSE 0

  CASE
    WHEN prior_90_revenue = 0 THEN NULL

)

  END AS growth_rate_pct

    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID), 0) AS repeat_customer_rate_pct
FROM (
    SELECT USER_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS order_count
    FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDERS
    GROUP BY USER_ID
) user_orders

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.CATEGORY,
        p.ID AS PRODUCT_ID,
        p.NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME,
        SUM(oi.SALE_PRICE) AS revenue
    FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS oi
    JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS p ON oi.PRODUCT_ID = p.ID
    WHERE oi.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    GROUP BY p.CATEGORY, p.ID, p.NAME
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CATEGORY ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rnk
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT
    CATEGORY,
    PRODUCT_ID,
    PRODUCT_NAME,
    revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY CATEGORY

WITH last_90d AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS spend_last_90d
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
),
prev_90d AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS spend_prev_90d
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT < DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.USER_ID) AS customers_with_higher_spend
FROM last_90d l
LEFT JOIN prev_90d p ON l.USER_ID = p.USER_ID
WHERE l.spend_last_90d > COALESCE(p.spend_prev_90d, 0)

WITH last_90_spend AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS revenue_last_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
),
prior_90_spend AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, SUM(SALE_PRICE) AS revenue_prior_90
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS
  WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    AND CREATED_AT >= DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 180 DAY
    AND CREATED_AT < DATE '2026-04-25' - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY USER_ID
),
combined AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.USER_ID, p.USER_ID) AS USER_ID,
         COALESCE(l.revenue_last_90, 0) AS revenue_last_90,
         COALESCE(p.revenue_prior_90, 0) AS revenue_prior_90
  FROM last_90_spend l
  FULL OUTER JOIN prior_90_spend p ON l.USER_ID = p.USER_ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_higher_spend
FROM combined
WHERE revenue_last_90 > revenue_prior_90

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, CREATED_AT,
         LAG(CREATED_AT) OVER (PARTITION BY USER_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS prev_order_date
  FROM ORDERS
),
days_between_orders AS (
  SELECT USER_ID,
         EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CREATED_AT - prev_order_date)) AS days_elapsed
  FROM customer_orders
  WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL
),
avg_per_customer AS (
  SELECT USER_ID, AVG(days_elapsed) AS avg_days
  FROM days_between_orders
  GROUP BY USER_ID
)
SELECT AVG(avg_days) AS avg_days_between_consecutive_orders
FROM avg_per_customer

    COUNT(*) AS total_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN OI.RETURNED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_items,
    SUM(CASE WHEN OI.RETURNED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS return_rate
FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS OI
JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS P
    ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
GROUP BY P.CATEGORY
ORDER BY return_rate DESC

SELECT 
  DATE_TRUNC('month', u.CREATED_AT) AS signup_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT u.ID) AS users_registered,
  SUM(oi.SALE_PRICE) AS total_revenue
FROM USERS u
LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON u.ID = oi.USER_ID 
  AND oi.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', u.CREATED_AT)
ORDER BY signup_month

SELECT
  P.CATEGORY,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN OI.RETURNED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS RETURN_RATE
FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS OI
JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.PRODUCTS P
  ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.ID
GROUP BY P.CATEGORY
ORDER BY RETURN_RATE DESC

WITH USER_COHORTS AS (
    SELECT
        ID AS USER_ID,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CREATED_AT) AS SIGNUP_MONTH
    FROM THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.USERS
),
COHORT_USERS AS (
    SELECT
        SIGNUP_MONTH,
        COUNT(DISTINCT USER_ID) AS USERS_REGISTERED
    FROM USER_COHORTS
    GROUP BY SIGNUP_MONTH
),
COHORT_REVENUE AS (
    SELECT
        uc.SIGNUP_MONTH,
        SUM(oi.SALE_PRICE) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
    FROM USER_COHORTS uc
    JOIN THELOOK_ECOMMERCE.ORDER_ITEMS oi
        ON uc.USER_ID = oi.USER_ID
    WHERE oi.STATUS NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
    GROUP BY uc.SIGNUP_MONTH
)
SELECT
    cu.SIGNUP_MONTH,
    cu.USERS_REGISTERED,
    COALESCE(cr.TOTAL_REVENUE, 0) AS TOTAL_REVENUE
FROM COHORT_USERS cu
LEFT JOIN COHORT_REVENUE cr
    ON cu.SIGNUP_MONTH = cr.SIGNUP_MONTH
ORDER BY cu.SIGNUP_MONTH

WITH monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP) AS month,
         SUM(oi.PRICE) AS business_volume
  FROM ORDER_ITEMS oi
  JOIN ORDERS o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.ORDER_PURCHASE_TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT month,
       business_volume,
       LAG(business_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prior_month_volume,
       CASE 
         WHEN LAG(business_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month) IS NULL THEN NULL
         ELSE 100.0 * (business_volume - LAG(business_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(business_volume) OVER (ORDER BY month)
       END AS mom_growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly_volume
ORDER BY month

    SUM(oi.PRICE) AS lifetime_volume
  FROM customer_first_order cfo
  JOIN ORDERS o ON o.CUSTOMER_ID IN (
    SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID 
    FROM CUSTOMERS c 
    WHERE c.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID = cfo.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID
  )
  JOIN ORDER_ITEMS oi ON o.ORDER_ID = oi.ORDER_ID
  WHERE o.ORDER_STATUS = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY cfo.CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID, cfo.acquisition_month
)
SELECT 
  acquisition_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_UNIQUE_ID) AS cohort_size,
  SUM(lifetime_volume) AS total_lifetime_volume
FROM customer_lifetime_volume
GROUP BY acquisition_month
ORDER BY acquisition_month
